history.description: Release Integrity v0.20.1 correction revision 4: preserve all prior functional fixes while making the incremental update path stable. Workflow files are manually bootstrapped once and are permanently forbidden inside update ZIPs; the root ZIP remains until validation passes; final status is reported only after commit/push.

Data Safety and Browser Matrix v0.20.2 correction revision 7: preserve the validated recovery, offline, Presentations control-state and functional-acceptance fixes. This revision changes no application runtime code; it removes one stale CHECKSUMS.sha256 entry for shared/vendor/pdfjs/README.md, which is absent from the real v0.20.1 repository tree. Hosted validation already passed 210/210 unit tests and 11/11 Chromium browser regressions before stopping only at this checksum-tree mismatch.

Functional Corrections v0.20.2.1 correction revision 2: fixes the two hosted browser-validation failures without changing the release target or workflow. Cross-workspace isolation now reads the editable Spreadsheet/Presentation title inputs correctly, and the PDF viewer safely ignores delayed resize work when no PDF document is active.

Refactoring Guardrails v0.20.2.2 correction 2: remove the stale checksum entry for shared/vendor/pdfjs/README.md, which the hosted v0.20.2.1 tree proves is absent, and add a fail-fast checksum-manifest regression to the unit suite. No application runtime or workflow file is changed.
